item.title: [IGNITE-732] IgniteCache.size() should not fail in case of topology changes.

item.summary: IgniteCache.size() should not fail in case of topology changes.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
1. SizeCallable should be replaced with ComputeTask implementation with full control over each result returned
  2. in case of topology changes exception should be ignored, size task relaunched to finish all the jobs on the same topology version.
  3. TaskWorker should not output exceptions for internal tasks like this.

1. Done with IgniteClosure. ComputeTask isn't best way to do it, because we need run it only on cache data nodes.
2. Done. But at unlucky time closure start on node where cache stopped already but node is still alive. As result we have NPE. Is it ok to catch them?
3. Now ClusterTopologyException logs only on debug level in GridTaskWorker.
IGNITE-834 addresses similar problem. The fix should be consistent.

Steps for reproduction:
1. Start 3 nodes with ExampleNodeStartup
2. Start StreamWords
3. Start QueryWords
4. Stop one node
